messages:
eli: Heads-up — proposing we add an opt-in SDK header for A/B routing so client can mark variants. Thinking header 'x-redwood-variant' with simple key=value pairs. Feedback?

jana: curious — why not keep all decision server-side? client opt-in helps offline rollout experiments (mobile) when we can't hit the control plane on each boot.

mike: +1 to supporting a client-side hint but must be non-authoritative. server must validate and bind to experiment config.

sara: privacy/Q: storing user_id->variant client-side vs server side. If we send a hashed id in header is that ok for GDPR? we need opt-in consent flow.

eli: Agreed. plan: header is a hint; server-side policy decides authoritative assignment. Also allow 'sticky=true' so clients can keep same variant locally but server still logs and can override.

pav: sketch of header: 
```
x-redwood-variant: experiment=exp_checkout_ui;variant=blue;sticky=true;seed=2026
x-redwood-trace: t=abc123;i=0
```

kevin: prefer shorter token to avoid header bloat: `x-rw-variant: exp=checkout:blue;st=1;seed=2026` Also we should include trace id to correlate telemetry.

deploy-bot: deploy scheduled by @mike for canary config rollout 1792346000

mike: We need consistent hashing algo across SDKs: murmur3_32(user_id + seed) % 100. Documented in console.

jana: And guardrails: if experiment is at >0 latency risk we must allow server to force baseline. So header ignored when `server_enforced=true` in rollout config.

eli: Also need a server header back to client to signal 'assigned' and 'fallback' so client UI can show correct variant immediately: `x-redwood-assigned: exp_checkout_ui=blue;fallback=false`.

sara: telemetry: ensure we tag traces with `experiment.id` and `experiment.variant` for slicing. Sampling should keep some % of experiment traffic at full detail.

pav: Edge case: offline first mobile — SDK holds last-assigned variant and only syncs on network. Must include TTL and assignment_ts in header so server can ignore stale assignments.

kevin: Example final header prototype:
```
x-rw-variant: exp=checkout_ui:blue;st=1;seed=2026;ts=1792340000
x-rw-trace: t=1f4b2
```

jana: UX in console: add checkbox 'allow client hints' + 'sticky cookie TTL' per experiment. Default off.

eli: Implementation tasks: SDK: parse header, compute local deterministic bucket, expose callback `onVariantAssigned(exp, variant)`. Server: accept hint, validate against rollout config, emit assigned header and telemetry tag.

mike: Security: sign the server-assigned token so SDK can verify it's not spoofed. HMAC with customer key.

sara: Also add opt-out header for users who revoked consent: `x-rw-consent: 0` — server must treat as no hint and assign server-side only.

eli: Sounds good. I'll open a design PR with a sample SDK patch + console flag. Anyone object? 

pav: no objections. please add unit tests for hashing parity across languages.

kevin: I'll take mobile SDK impl. mike will own server validation + signature.

eli: thanks — I'll post the PR link when ready. :tada:
